description: Verify an agent purchase before you accept it (Agent Commerce Check): returns allow, step_up or deny with reasons and an evidence_id kept 400 days. Send the agent's signed HTTP request (method, url, headers; add body or body_b64 when the request was signed over it), the cart/1, the merchant policy, and the mandate (or an OE-Mandate header). Free, no key.

approval.description: {approval: approval/2.0, verifier_did, request_id}: the owner's approval of this exact cart, after a step_up

cart.description: cart/1: profile, merchant, agent_did, lines, total, currency, rail, mandate_id

mandate.description: mandate/1, when not in an OE-Mandate header

policy.description: agent_policy: min_level, require_owner, require_mandate, min_security_band, accept_issuers, min_owner_level; or {merchant: <did>} to use the policy that merchant published

name: openentity_commerce_check
